text: Project-based learning (PBL) is a teaching method in which students learn by actively engaging in real-world and personally meaningful projects. Instead of memorizing facts for a test, students investigate a driving question over an extended period, producing a tangible product or presentation that reflects their understanding.

text: A good driving question is open-ended, tied to real-world issues, and framed in student-friendly language. It should be broad enough to allow multiple valid approaches, yet specific enough to anchor several weeks of inquiry and give students a clear sense of purpose.
description: Sample chunk written for this demo repository, not derived from any third-party source.

text: Formative assessment in project-based learning happens continuously through checkpoints, peer feedback, and teacher conferences, rather than relying solely on a single end-of-project grade. This lets teachers catch misconceptions early and helps students revise their work before the final presentation.
description: Sample chunk written for this demo repository, not derived from any third-party source.

text: Effective collaboration in a PBL classroom depends on clearly defined roles, shared accountability, and structured routines for resolving disagreements. Teachers often introduce a team contract at the start of a project so that expectations around communication and workload are explicit from day one.
description: Sample chunk written for this demo repository, not derived from any third-party source.

text: Reflection is a core practice in project-based learning: students step back periodically to evaluate what they have learned, what strategies worked, and what they would change next time. This metacognitive habit helps transfer skills from one project to the next.
description: Sample chunk written for this demo repository, not derived from any third-party source.

text: In a mathematics PBL unit, students might analyze real household energy bills to model cost as a function of usage, then present recommendations for reducing consumption. This grounds abstract algebraic concepts like slope and rate of change in a concrete, personally relevant context.
description: Sample chunk written for this demo repository, not derived from any third-party source.

text: A science PBL project on local water quality might have students collect samples, run basic chemical tests, and propose interventions to a simulated town council. The engineering design process (ask, imagine, plan, create, test) provides a natural structure for this kind of inquiry.

text: 项目式学习（PBL）是一种以学生为中心的教学方式，学生围绕一个真实、有意义的驱动性问题展开持续数周的探究，最终产出可以公开展示的成果，而不是单纯为了应付一次考试而记忆知识点。

text: 在项目式学习中，形成性评价贯穿项目全过程，通过阶段性检查点、同伴互评和教师面谈等方式持续进行，而不是仅仅依赖项目结束时的一次终结性评分，这样可以让教师及时发现学生的理解偏差，并在最终展示前给学生留出修改空间。
